title: Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for this reactor hardware chemical processing application where HCl/H2SO4 resistance up to 200C is required beyond CP grades. Mo+Ni stabilize the passive film in crevice conditions. This rationale is driven by autoclave agitator shaft (grade 5) and fat life requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for reactor hardware geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with SPC sampling
TIG welding Grade 2 with SPC sampling
Hydrostatic shell test with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for autoclave agitator shaft application
commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability — critical for autoclave agitator shaft performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft suitable for Autoclave agitator shaft (Grade 5)?
faq.a: Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft uses Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address reactor hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for autoclave agitator shaft requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. autoclave agitator shaft components require Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for autoclave agitator shaft application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet autoclave agitator shaft specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Agitator shaft / Mixer shaft reactor hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
